record.vts_name: VTS costeiro do continente (Coast of Portugal VTS; call sign 'Roca Control')
record.vts_authority: Direção-Geral de Recursos Naturais, Segurança e Serviços Marítimos (DGRM); statute names IPTM, I.P. (predecessor)
record.vts_centre: Centro de Controlo de Tráfego Marítimo do Continente (CCTMC), Paço de Arcos
record.vts_boundary_basis: DL 263/2009 art. 6 VTS area runs from the coast to 010 14 W (north of 38 41 N) and then to 36 30 N 009 35 W; art. 10(4) gives the CCTMC supervision of TSS rules. Coordinate comparison: the westernmost TSS positions (26) 010 13.78 W, (25) 38 40.96 N 010 13.77 W and (24) 38 33.92 N 010 11.69 W all fall inside (margins about 0.2').
record.reporting_boundary_basis: COPREP area (MSC.278(85)) has the same west and south-west limits; the TSS falls inside on coordinate comparison (TSS not named in COPREP). Also WETREP (VRS-0005): 'Off Cape Roca' named in MSC.190(79) 6.2.1 and inside the area; Portuguese WETREP contact is Roca Control (MSC.301(87)); tanker-only.
record.evidence_summary: Statutory coastal VTS area and COPREP area both include the TSS on coordinate comparison; WETREP names it. Reports to Roca Control; CCTMC listed as operational 24h/7 under DGRM.
record.source_date: DL 263/2009; MSC.278(85) 2008 (in force 1 June 2009); COLREG.2/Circ.61 (TSS implemented 1 Dec 2010); EMSA directory accessed 2026
record.unresolved_issue: Coverage rests on coordinate comparison with narrow margins (about 0.2' of longitude); consolidated current text of DL 263/2009 not opened; DGRM own web page not opened.
record.prior_lead_outcome: confirmed: VTS + MRS; operator updated to DGRM via EMSA directory; WETREP added
